prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1079; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear quarter panel and bumper cover show crushed plastic and a creased fender consistent with the reported collision during a left turn. Damage pattern lines up with the impact described by the insured, and no older prior damage has been found on the vehicle. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, refinishing the quarter panel, and aligning the rear sensor bracket. Labor hours submitted fit the extent of the damage, and the parts and billing records show no duplicated or repeated charges.
